art_direction: 多条宽窄曲带像潮沟环绕一块中央浅岛，蓝绿与沙色层次清楚。
composition: one original focal subject, centered and readable within a circular avatar crop
creative_direction: Design an abstract tidal map from five interlocking curved bands surrounding a central sand-colored island shape. Alternate deep blue, sea green, pale aqua, warm sand, and one small coral inlet. Let the bands change width and branch once, creating a sense of flowing water without realistic geography. Keep the center open and the outer perimeter nearly circular for avatar readability. Add a few small flat pebble accents only near one edge. Use no lines, labels, gradients, or contour-map text. Create a square 1024x1024 avatar with a clear central silhouette that remains legible at thumbnail size. Use an original text-only composition, without lettering, logos, signatures, or watermarks.
style_inspiration: Original artwork from written art direction; prior conversation informs general design preferences, no prior image pixels reused or uploaded.
visual_review: passed: compressed preview inspected for clear original focal composition, requested medium and detail level, circular-crop readability, no unintended anatomy or rendering defects, no text or watermark
